test_title: PYST 12: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On : 13 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: If a shopkeeper offers a 10% discount, he makes a 10% profit. Under the same conditions, if he offers a 25% discount, then how much percentage of profit or loss will he get?
solution:
**Given Data:**

Profit after 10% discount = 10%

Second discount offered = 25%

**Concept:**

Profit% = Profit/CP × 100

Loss% = Loss/CP × 100

SP = (100 - Discount%)/100&
